name: Japanese grammar (≈ JLPT levels)
attribution: Japanese grammar lessons written for qinqin; CC0 1.0. The selection and order of grammar points per level are qinqin's own (the JLPT publishes no grammar list; nothing is taken from JLPT preparation books or published lists). Levels are estimates. Not reviewed by a native speaker.
notice:
Japanese grammar lessons written for qinqin, released under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The JLPT publishes no grammar list. The choice of grammar points per level and their order are qinqin's own, not taken from JLPT preparation books or other published lists; the explanations, example sentences, readings, translations and exercise answers are written for qinqin.

The levels are qinqin's estimates ("≈ N5" to "≈ N1"), not official JLPT levels. The content has not been reviewed by a native speaker; corrections are welcome.
